# Observator — llms.txt

> Observator is a conditional settlement layer for machine-to-machine payments
> on Solana: escrowed funds release only when deterministic, machine-verifiable
> delivery conditions pass. Deterministic checks — never LLM output — control
> settlement. Status: working prototype; escrow program written, Devnet deploy
> in progress.

- Product summary: README.md ("What is Observator?", "Key facts", "FAQ")
- Build spec (authoritative): OBSERVATOR_MASTER_BUILD_SPEC.md
- Architecture: docs/architecture.md
- Verification contract: docs/verification-spec.md
- Demo script (both paths): docs/demo-script.md
- Submission narrative: docs/submission-narrative.md
- Judge Q&A: docs/judge-qa.md
- x402 adapter: docs/x402-note.md
- Progress + checkpoints: docs/implementation-checklist.md
- Backend entry: apps/api/src/index.ts (routes: apps/api/src/routes/jobs.ts)
- Verification engine: apps/api/src/verification/engine.ts
- Dashboard: apps/web/app (create, jobs, jobs/[id])
- MCP server: apps/mcp/src/index.ts (tools: apps/mcp/src/tools.ts)
- Escrow program: programs/observator-escrow/src/lib.rs
- Demo provider: demo/provider/src/index.ts
